question: In a certain code language, “ABROAD” is written as “DROBAA”, and “ACTIVE” is written as “ETICAV”. How will “BISHOP” be written in that language?
solution:
The answer is option 3) PSHIBO

**SOLUTION:**

The pattern given in the given series is:

 
• **1st character moves to 5th place**
 
• **2ⁿd character moves to 4th place**
 
• **3rd character moves to 2ⁿd place**
 
• **4th character moves to 3rd place**
 
• **5th character moves to 6th place**
 
• **6th character moves to 1st place**

 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55b287b3382d77683fdf516e47c89837c21da7fc302943c1cb4dbebe9fd3e009.png] **
**ABROAD becomes DROBAA**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc65c320b65ef6e218399db4ecff7ff948b2d857ebc506a927f525c883eb4138.png] 

**ACTIVE becomes ETICAV**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f779a4b7543c9b74c15948a2b8445f092cdea352f4c93ee02bbc718f4d8d46ef.png] 

**BISHOP becomes PSHIBO**

 **Hence **the correct answer is PSHIBO**
